sources.snippet: mT5 # Released in 2020, Google's mT5 is a multilingual language model based on the transformer encoder-decoder framework. Leveraging a massive multilingual dataset with over 100 languages, mT5 achieved state-of-the-art benchmark scores across multiple languages.
